name: create_event_causal
description: Record a directed causal link from one event to another. Cycles across distinct events are allowed; an event cannot cause itself. Cause may occur later in game time than its effect.

from.description: Cause event UUID — the event this link originates from (от какого события).

to.description: Effect event UUID — the event this link leads to (к какому событию).

cause.description: Narrative description of the causal link.
